name: bizplug-dermatology
description: The dermatology & skin plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book skin-care visits. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, availability and appointment requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Scheduling and information only: never give medical, mental-health or clinical advice, and never ask for symptoms or records. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
